schema_note: Per-function protection status for the Factory's customer-facing generators and shared systems. Seeded 2026-09-12 from a read-only audit -- see PROTECTED_GENERATOR_RULE.md and SESSION_HANDOFF_2026-09-11.md. Status values: LOCKED (proven customer-path fix + machine-checked protected test(s) + known last_known_good_commit), UNLOCKED (an explicit, reasoned, in-progress exception -- see unlocked_by/unlocked_reason), PROTECTED (real test coverage exists but no single commit has been proven as its customer-path last-known-good), UNPROTECTED (no meaningful customer-path test coverage), REGRESSION (currently known broken). last_known_good_commit is null unless a real commit was proven -- never manufactured (Rule 9, PROTECTED_GENERATOR_RULE.md). shared_code_dependencies covers both the function's own dedicated files and any file it shares with other functions -- tests/test_function_lock_enforcement.py treats a trailing '/' as a directory-prefix match.

word_search.relocked_after_tests: tests/test_word_search_topic_scope_contract.py (8 tests), full Word Search suite (40 tests), Fast Stability Gate (148 passed), full Windows release gate (2647 tests)
word_search.notes: The customer-facing route had never used the shared topic engine, in any release, until a021385. No earlier commit is a valid last-known-good for this route.

coloring_book.relocked_after_tests: tests/test_coloring_book_interior_no_text_contract.py (3 tests/10 subtests), full coloring-book suite (74 tests), Fast Stability Gate (151 passed), full Windows release gate (2656 tests)
coloring_book.notes: LOCKED for the captions-off/no-text contract proven at 984b268. Seven pre-existing *_LOCKED_STATE.md files (2026-07-11/07-12) claimed this same behavior; their manual test theme ('Farm House') never exercised the one illustration branch (_draw_generic_scene) that had the defect, and none were machine-checked. Those files are historical record now, not the source of truth -- this entry is. A separate, unrelated pair of crash bugs was found in _draw_fantasy (dragon/castle themes) during this fix and is flagged separately (not part of this lock).

crossword.notes: The only generator formally enrolled in PROTECTED_GENERATOR_RULE.md before 2026-09-12. e81298e is the commit that both created the shared topic engine and fixed Crossword's topic-scope contamination and dropped-answer-key defects (2026-09-09).

invite_protection.notes: Self-contained in app.py's single before_request hook -- no shared dependency on static/js/app.js (the gate is server-rendered, no fetch/JS involvement). 14+2 real behavioral tests: gate on/off, cookie/header/query admission, wrong-code refusal (never echoed), exemptions, admin routes gated too.

factory_market_advantage.notes: Real, substantial test coverage exists (heavily mocked, algorithm-level: scoring, dedup, fabrication guards). Not LOCKED because: no Fast Gate coverage, no proven customer-path commit, and the 2026-09-11 incident (TAVILY_API_KEY / AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY missing on Render) was entirely invisible to every existing test -- it was a configuration gap, not a code defect, and no test here would have caught it. Fixed by the owner via Render Environment tab; code unchanged.

ebook.notes: Largest test family in the Factory (~31 files in tests/acceptance_manifest.json), but only 1-2 run in the Fast Gate. No single commit has been formally proven as this function's customer-path last-known-good -- not LOCKED until one is.

math_worksheet.notes: Fully independent generator (shares no product-specific code with any other Factory product). Full Gate only -- not in the Fast Gate today.

faith_planner.notes: Shares services/planner/ with Budget Planner -- a Faith-only change can silently affect Budget Planner; one shared test file (37 tests) covers both. The 2026-09-09 matrix noted a 'Save Product' flakiness in one manual browser trial, concluded not a generation defect, but never formally re-verified.

budget_planner.notes: Shares services/planner/ with Faith Planner -- see that entry. Same shared test file covers both.

saved_projects.notes: The one function with real code-level enforcement, not just tests: services/quality/artifact_state.py's DRAFT/APPROVED/LOCKED transition rules genuinely block content mutation in code. Strong candidate for LOCKED; kept at PROTECTED because no single customer-path incident/fix commit was named for it in the 2026-09-12 audit -- upgrade it deliberately, not by default.

pdf_zip_export.notes: Highest-blast-radius shared file in the Factory per the Shared-Service Dependency Map -- every other product above lists services/packaging.py as a dependency too, so a change here should re-run every locked/protected function's suite, not just this one.
